subject: Backend Engineer, Payments: Jordan Reyes
body:
Hello Northwind Pay hiring team,

Your July post-mortem on the card retry spike described a problem I fixed at Tidewater Freight in 2025. Retries were piling up behind one slow partner bank. Per-bank retry budgets fixed it, and duplicate charge complaints fell from about 30 a week to 3.

That is why the Backend Engineer, Payments role stood out. For the last 4 years I've built Go payment services at Tidewater Freight, including the mandate retry service, which handles about 1 million requests a day. The post asks for recurring card mandates and Go, which is my daily work.

My tailored resume is attached. My notice period is 30 days, and I'd be glad to walk through the retry design in an interview.

Regards,
